scripts.env:init: echo | infisical run echo >/dev/null 2>&1 || sh -c 'echo Run "infisical login" first. && exit 1'
scripts.env:push-dev: npm run env:init && infisical secrets set --file .env
scripts.env:DANGEROUS-push-prod: npm run env:init && infisical secrets set --env=prod --file .env.production
scripts.env:pull-prod: npm run env:init && infisical export --env=prod --format=dotenv > .env.production && echo Pulled prod env to .env.production
scripts.env:pull-dev: npm run env:init && infisical --silent export --format=dotenv > .env && echo Pulled dev env to .env
